name: Gooms: A Physics Puzzle
detailed_description:
Get ready to challenge your logic in a world full of physics, strategy, and creativity! Gooms is a puzzle game featuring 4 distinct stages, each with 30 unique levels—including a special level in each stage designed to push your skills to the limit.

Explore diverse and visually rich environments: from lush forests and mysterious ruins to an abandoned spaceship and the vastness of outer space. Each setting brings its own challenges and a huge variety of objects with realistic physics properties to manipulate.

To succeed, you must arrange the environment before activating physics—position turbines with strong or reverse winds, cannons that launch objects with precision, creators that spawn essential pieces, and detonators that control timed destruction. Use pressure buttons and switches to power mechanisms, conveyors to move objects, gravity fields that simulate orbits, and even rockets that explode on impact.

The arsenal of objects is vast: bouncy balls, tires, motorized wheels, balloons that lift heavy loads, gears that fit into complex mechanisms, chains, cushions to soften falls, and tools to pin, throw, and control everything in your path.

But beware! Dangerous areas with laser beams, deadly zones that destroy anything they touch, and gravity inverters that completely change the game’s rules await you.

With dozens of clever and challenging levels, Gooms is the physics puzzle that will keep you hooked and test your creativity with every move.

short_description: Gooms é um jogo de quebra-cabeça de física inspirado em Rube Goldberg Machines, onde você organiza objetos do cenário para resolver desafios, combinando lógica, estratégia e criatividade para guiar os personagens até o portal e completar o nível.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM

  • Storage: 200 MB available space
